nodes.text: explore 0 (web-domain-researcher 0): One explore sub-agent reads the complete benchmark at `http://localhost:30309` exactly once and returns the complete benchmark payload with field and count controls. Do not query WooCommerce, write files, or run the processor.

explore 1 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): One explore sub-agent exhausts the required WooCommerce products and orders with `perPage` at most 100 and terminal-page checks. Paginate `woo_products_list` and `woo_orders_list` with increasing literal `page` until a short or empty terminal page proves exhaustion; omit the optional order `status` and preserve every observed status. Return compact product and order records plus page/count/null/duplicate controls. Do not modify the store, write files, or run the processor.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): The coder sub-agent receives both frozen payloads and uniquely owns the required JSON inputs, `wc_coupons_processor.py`, and `wc_coupons_results.json`. Produce exact alphabetical category rows with `Product_Count`, `Our_Avg_Price`, `Total_Sales`, `Market_Avg_Price`, and `Price_Gap_Pct`, plus metrics and supported recommendations. Run and read back the result, then return its path/hash, source/page/count controls, eligible categories, and schema checks. It must not fetch localhost or WooCommerce and must not create the final Excel or Google Sheet.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 1): One coder sub-agent is the sole writer of `Coupon_Effectiveness_Report.xlsx`. Read only the verified result. Create exactly `Data_Analysis`, `Metrics`, and `Recommendations`: `Data_Analysis` has literal columns `Category, Product_Count, Our_Avg_Price, Total_Sales, Market_Avg_Price, Price_Gap_Pct` sorted alphabetically by Category; `Metrics` has `Metric, Value`; `Recommendations` contains source-supported priority actions. Write literal values and read back every populated range.

coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): One coder sub-agent is the sole owner of the Google Sheet `Wc Coupons Tracker`. Read only the verified result, exhaust `search_spreadsheets` for the exact title, create it once only when absent, and block on multiple exact matches. Write the exact alphabetical category rows with `Category, Product_Count, Our_Avg_Price, Total_Sales, Market_Avg_Price, Price_Gap_Pct` plus a compact verified metrics section, then read both ranges back.
